'''Momopo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Lulupo]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Mud is not dirty. It is the most natural sunscreen around, not that anyone who neglects proper skincare would understand."

Momopo is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A baby hippopotamus that wears a pink ruffled headband. Its body is brown with a lighter brown underbelly. It also seems to be wearing pink lipstick and has purple eyes.

Momopo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its pink headband to purple, and its body becomes reddish-brown instead of brown.

== Evolution Trial ==
Momopo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Lulupo]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed 10 Rock Sugar Rings.

== Trivia ==
* Momopo and its evolutions were added to the game on 6/3/2026 alongside [[Cosmoram]] and [[Heliabloom]].
